diagram_title: PRD-BOM crosscheck gate: enforce C00 main_components fulfilment on the C03 netlist before C04 entry

activities.title: Structure main_components
activities.description: One-shot upstream extraction: turn the C00 answer_state main_components sentence into a structured, human-auditable component-role manifest (roles, quantities, allowed alternatives, match patterns) persisted to disk. LLM does this once; the artifact is the auditable contract.

activities.title: Parse C03 netlist
activities.description: Deterministic S-expr parse of the exported .net: extract ref / value / footprint / lib-symbol per component. No LLM.

activities.title: Crosscheck manifest vs netlist
activities.description: Deterministic per-role matching (pattern over value/footprint/symbol + quantity check) producing present / substituted / missing verdicts and a BLOCKING list for missing roles and out-of-envelope substitutions without recorded user approval.

activities.title: Enforce gate at C03 readiness
activities.description: Wire the crosscheck verdict into C03 readiness: any BLOCKING item unresolved refuses C04 entry; substitution decisions are user-owned and recorded in the manifest approvals field.

arrows.label: PRD wording is the envelope SSOT; extraction must not invent roles
no-silent-fallback: missing manifest or unreadable netlist = explicit error
MCP tool bodesign_prd_bom_crosscheck + C03 readiness assessor
gate verdict: C04 entry allowed | refused with BLOCKING evidence
